method: Rasch-style ridge LS (lambda=0.25) on within-benchmark z-scores, provenance offsets estimated; bootstrap CI over 400 resamples; benchmarks with <5 models excluded

estimated_ranking.note: no target-benchmark data exists for these models; theta is family (company/series from known-llm-models.md) interpolation or extrapolation over release position. NOT comparable in precision with the data-backed ranking; wide CIs are intentional.
